title: Source Session Handoff — authenticated context wire (v1.0)
description: Public-safe issuer-attested context after server-side redemption under profile oauth2-authorization-code-pkce-s256-v1. This object is not an OAuth token response. A valid context does not authenticate receiver identity and does not grant permission, role, membership, runtime admission, or access. Source role and permission references are source-attested bounds only. Browser-authored copies are never trusted.

profile.description: Selects the frozen OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code profile with PKCE S256 only.

handoff_ref.description: Handoff attempt this context belongs to. Compared by exact string equality with the initiation.

transaction_ref.description: Opaque transaction correlation. Compared by exact string equality with the initiation.

issuer.description: Issuer that attested this context. Mix-up defence compares it with the initiation issuer by exact string equality.

audience.description: Receiver binding. A bound pair requires exact equality with the initiation receiver_ref. Equality is not authenticated identity and does not grant access.

receiver_ref.description: Intended receiving party. Compared by exact string equality with the initiation. Presence does not create a receiver role.

client_ref.description: Registered client binding. Compared by exact string equality with the initiation.

subject_ref.description: Issuer-scoped subject. It is not a receiver account and is not authenticated by schema validity or by hash equality.

source_session_ref.description: Opaque source session reference. It does not issue a receiver session.

source_context_ref.description: Opaque source context reference. It is distinct from source_session_ref under the semantic rules.

organisation_ref.description: Issuer-scoped organisation reference. A browser-authored value is not trusted and does not create receiver membership.

account_ref.description: Issuer-scoped account reference. It is not a receiver account grant.

record_scope_refs.description: Explicit record scopes attested by the issuer. They must be a non-empty subset of the initiation request. Presence does not grant receiver access.

source_role_ref.description: Source-attested role bound only. It does not create a receiver role.

source_permission_refs.description: Source-attested permission bounds only. They do not create receiver permissions.

destination_uri.description: Destination binding. A bound pair requires exact string equality with the initiation destination_uri.

issued_at.description: Time the issuer attested this context at server-side redemption.

expires_at.description: End of the context lifetime. Conformance requires a strictly positive duration no greater than 5 minutes.

correlation_ref.description: Correlation shared with the initiation and any failure for this attempt.
